description: This file defines the PackageInfo class, which serves as a container for a package of classes and interfaces within the Android APK check tool. It manages class information including creation, retrieval, and iteration over classes in a specific package.

classes.name: PackageInfo
classes.description: Represents a package containing multiple classes and interfaces, providing methods to access, create, and iterate over classes within the package.

methods.name: PackageInfo
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the PackageInfo with a given package name.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the package.

methods.name: getClass
methods.description: Retrieves a ClassInfo object by class name from the package.

methods.name: getOrCreateClass
methods.description: Retrieves an existing ClassInfo object by class name, or creates it if it doesn't exist, using class name, superclass name, and static attribute.

methods.name: getClassIterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over all ClassInfo objects in the package.
